input.prompt:
You are a fork building ONE part of the Sounding frontend. Write only these files: /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/Meetings.jsx and /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/Collections.jsx (replace the stubs), plus /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/lists.css (import it from both). Do not edit any other file. Do not deploy, restart services, or touch the GPU box.

Use helpers from ../api.js (get/post/patch/put/del/useApi/qs/clipUrl/busy) and ../ui.jsx (Modal, Menu, Tabs, Field, Spinner, Loading, ErrorNote, Empty, PageHead, Avatar, fmtClock, fmtDate, fmtDay, copyText, absLink, go, setQuery, useApp, useAction) and ../rows.jsx (MeetingRows, MeetingRow). The API is exactly the backend in /root/fathom-clone/server/sounding/routes (read meetings.py, collab.py, intel.py for shapes). useApp() gives { me, org, teams, isAdmin, members, toast, openUpload }.

Meetings.jsx exports:
- `MeetingsPage({ scope })` for scope mine | team | shared. Titles: "My calls", "Team calls", "Shared with me". GET /meetings?scope=…&team_id=&type_id= ; poll every 3s while any row is busy, else every 20s. Filters: team select (team scope), meeting type select (GET /org/meeting-types), and a quick filter box that filters loaded rows by title/overview/speaker. Group rows by day headings (Today, Yesterday, weekday date). Row actions menu (via MeetingRows rowActions): Open, Add to folder (modal using GET /folders + POST /folders/{fid}/items, quick-create), Copy link (absLink('#/meeting/'+id)). Empty states: mine → invite to upload (button calls openUpload()) and explain drag-and-drop; team → explain that teammates' meetings shared with a team or the organization appear here; shared → explain.
- `SearchPage({ q })`: GET /search?q= ; show results with title/date and up to 3 moments each (speaker, text with the query terms highlighted using <mark>, timestamp link to #/meeting/{id}?t={t}). Offer "Ask Sounding instead" link to #/ask?q=… .

Collections.jsx exports:
- `FoldersPage()`: list folders (name, count, owner, shared badge), create folder modal (name + "Share with everyone in the organization" checkbox, with a note that sharing a folder gives everyone access to its meetings), rename/delete via menu for can-edit (owner or admin — compute from owner_id vs me.id or isAdmin).
- `FolderPage({ id })`: GET /folders/{id}; rows with "Remove from folder" action for can_edit; rename/share toggle/delete; an "Ask about these meetings" box that POSTs /ask {question, folder_id} and renders the answer with citations [M3 12:34] turned into links using refs (#/meeting/{id}?t=seconds) — write a small local citation renderer.
- `PlaylistsPage()`: list/create (name + shared checkbox), menu rename/delete.
- `PlaylistPage({ id })`: GET /playlists/{id}; list clips (title, meeting title linked if can_open_meeting, duration, who made it, note); a player that plays a selected clip (audio via clipUrl(h.id) or video via clipUrl(h.id,'video') when has_video) and "Play all" that auto-advances; reorder with Move up/Move down (PUT /playlists/{id}/order), remove (DELETE item), share toggle, copy a link to a clip (POST /meetings/{meeting_id}/links {access:'org', highlight_id}).
- `CompaniesPage()`: GET /companies; list domain, meetings count, people count, last meeting date; empty state explaining companies come from attendee emails on uploads.
- `CompanyPage({ domain })`: GET /companies/{domain}; people list, meetings rows, and an "Ask about {domain}" box (POST /ask {question, company: domain}) with the same citation renderer.

Responsive at 390px without horizontal overflow; visible focus; aria labels on icon buttons. Style: follow /root/fathom-clone/src/styles.css tokens/classes; prefix new classes with `ls-`. Writing: sentence case, plain verbs, buttons say what they do, errors explain how to fix; no all-caps labels, no emoji.

Verify with: cd /root/fathom-clone && npx vite build --outDir /tmp/claude-0/-root/a2db516c-9100-4760-bff1-2f9fe28ddb93/scratchpad/build-lists (must succeed; other pages may still be stubs). Then report what you implemented, anything skipped, and backend gaps you noticed (don't fix backend yourself).

text:
I wrote the lists, search, folders, playlists and companies pages. The build succeeds (`vite build` into `scratchpad/build-lists`), but I haven't checked them in a browser.

I only touched three files: `src/pages/Meetings.jsx`, `src/pages/Collections.jsx` and `src/pages/lists.css`. There are no commits.

**Meetings.jsx**
- **`MeetingsPage({ scope })`:**
  - Covers My calls, Team calls and Shared with me.
  - It polls every 3 s while a meeting is processing and every 20 s otherwise.
  - Filters: a quick text filter over title, overview, speakers and owner; a team filter on Team calls; a meeting-type filter.
  - Rows are grouped under day headings: Today, Yesterday, then weekday and date.
  - Each row's menu has Open, Add to folder and Copy link.
  - Each scope has its own empty state. On My calls it offers an upload button and explains drag-and-drop. With filters on, it offers "Clear filters".
- **Also exported for reuse:** `AddToFolderModal` (pick a folder or create one and add to it), `meetingMenu`, `groupByDay` and `Highlighted`.
- **`SearchPage({ q })`:** matching meetings with up to 3 moments each. Query words are highlighted with `<mark>`, timestamps link to `#/meeting/{id}?t=…`, and there's an "Ask Sounding instead" link to `#/ask?q=…`.

**Collections.jsx**
- **Citations:** answers turn `[M3 12:34]` and `[M3]` into links to that meeting and moment, using the `refs` returned by `/ask`. There's also an ask box with suggestions, a question thread and a "Searched N meetings" count.
- **Folders:** card grid with create, rename, change sharing and delete. The share checkbox warns that a shared folder opens its meetings to everyone.
- **One folder:** its meetings, with Remove from folder for people who can edit it, an edit menu, and "Ask about these meetings" sent with `folder_id`.
- **Playlists:** same card grid as folders.
- **One playlist:**
  - A player that switches between audio and video clips, and Play all, which moves to the next clip when one ends.
  - Clip list: title, source meeting (linked if you can open it), length, who made it, and the note.
  - Clip menu: Move up and Move down, Remove, Open in meeting, and Copy clip link, which creates an organisation-only link.
  - Sharing toggle.
- **Companies:** domain, meeting count, people count and last-met date. The empty state explains that companies come from attendee emails.
- **One company:** its meetings, its people, and an "Ask about {domain}" box.

**Layout and wording**
- All class names start with `ls-`.
- At phone width, the side-by-side layouts become a single column, and the sticky ask box and player stop sticking.
- Icon buttons have aria labels, text is in sentence case, and copy failures show an error toast.

**Skipped:** nothing from the brief.

**Backend gaps I noticed (not fixed)**
- `/api/ask` with `folder_id` doesn't check that the folder is visible to the caller. It relies on meeting visibility alone, so this is harmless but loose.
- `/api/search` returns no owner or speakers, so search results can't show faces.
- Removing a meeting from a folder isn't blocked when you can edit the folder but not the meeting. That seems fine, but I'm noting it.
